title: Weather-tolerant double climb, low altitude
terrain: forested / non-exposed, 2 x ~400m D+, total D- ~800m non-technical
coachNotes: ARPA gives a perturbed phase Thursday to Sunday with widespread, locally intense rain, and the 18 Aug local forecast puts the wettest window on Friday and Saturday with Sunday improving (23C, storm risk decreasing). So this is written to be done in rain, not in a window. Tree line and below, no crests, no exposed traverses, no via ferrata cable sections, abort to the valley on the first thunder. Wet limestone is the reason this is not the Presolana. FALLBACK if it is electrical rather than just wet: 2h30 indoor trainer, 3x20m at 84-89% LTHR with 10m easy between, then 20m flat jog off the bike, load 130. Take the fallback without negotiating, the weekend is aerobic maintenance now, the descent stimulus was Wednesday. PRE-AUTHORISED SWAP: if by Friday evening Sunday clearly has the better window, swap this session with Sunday's one-for-one, loads and all (Sat 80 rolling, Sun 140 double climb). Tell me and I will re-publish so the tracker matches. Do not run both days big. Eat every 40 minutes either way, the fuelling rehearsal still has to happen. Garmin expect 230-280.
